name: Upstash Serverless Data Platform OG image by upstash.com
description: A 1200×630 social card on a near-black canvas with a subtle dark-green vignette glow. A single massive white two-line headline ("Serverless / Data Platform") dominates the top two-thirds, with a row of rounded dark pill badges beneath showing five product logos and names in per-product accent colours (red, orange, blue, purple, green). A green underlined domain link with a playful cursor graphic anchors the bottom. Hierarchy is strictly vertical and centered: headline → product pills → URL, with generous negative space keeping it legible at thumbnail size.
